groups.oct_why: floor spread 1.7071 mm (22.52 deg at 6 GHz) exceeds max_spread_mm 1.0: shortest member N >= 58.0105 mm, longest P >= 59.7176 mm. An octilinear router (KRT moves in 8 directions, so the shortest pad-to-pad copper is max(dx,dy)+0.4142*min(dx,dy)) cannot do better — accepted because `elongation: meander` is declared and route.yaml carries executable endpoint_length_matching/canonicalize_chains, so the short members are deliberately lengthened. The realized spread below is the check that the elongation actually happened.
